StarBuddyStarBuddy

Xingya desktop assistant

Phase 0

A personal computer assistant built around the original Xingya character, currently offering a frontend shell and growth-system preview.

Xingya is being extracted from Starclip. The repository contains frontend code and a draft gateway protocol. Transparent desktop windows, dragging and edge snapping require desktop integration; the daemon and agent adapters are not implemented yet.

Vue · TypeScript · ViteFrontend previewMIT

Current status: The preview uses in-memory demo data and cannot yet schedule local agents such as Claude Code or Codex.

Features and progress

  • Xingya expressions, animations, interaction menus and growth system
  • Preview the frontend shell in a browser
  • Desktop integration, a daemon and agent scheduling adapters remain to be implemented

Platforms and distribution

The frontend shell can be previewed in a browser. No standalone desktop installer is available yet.

Start from source

These startup commands come from the repository README. Read the original documentation for dependencies and configuration.

npm install
npm run dev
